moments.text: Handheld phone video of a dark night sky. A blurred red glow sits just right of centre.
The glow resolves into two red lights, one directly above the other. Focus keeps pulsing, merging them into one blob at times.
The camera drifts off the lights for about three seconds; the frame is almost empty.
The image goes far out of focus: a faint pink haze that slowly sharpens back into two soft red discs.
Back in focus, the lower light now sits below and slightly left of the upper one.
The pair has tilted further: the lower light is now down and to the left on a diagonal, and the two look closer together.
The two lights now sit almost side by side, the left one just lower than the right.
The left light is now slightly higher than the right. Focus still pulses, with a long blur at 2:23-2:29, to the end.
